<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>Notes:</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Loading into Fort Forinthry is very intensive. The following reduces load times</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Reducing draw distance, and turning off textures.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ When you use </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="dive">[[File:Dive.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>dive</nowiki>|<nowiki>dive</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> towards Zemouregal, hover your mouse over the northwest part of the minimap, so you can quickly </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="dive">[[File:Dive.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>dive</nowiki>|<nowiki>dive</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>. It is a bit difficult to click on Zemouregal when quickly using </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="dive">[[File:Dive.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>dive</nowiki>|<nowiki>dive</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> though, so keep that in mind. (needs investigation)</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;padding:0.8em 1em;border:1px solid #9eb1a7;border-radius:5px;line-height:2.1;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.07);"><nowiki>⬥ Ballista timing assumes you perfectly </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="dive">[[File:Dive.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>dive</nowiki>|<nowiki>dive</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> → (tc) + </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="gsunshine">[[File:Greater Sunshine.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>gsunshine</nowiki>|<nowiki>gsunshine</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>. If you are late in any way, the timings will be different, so exercise caution.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="amhej">[[File:Am-hej.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448070604937891921.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>amhej</nowiki>|<nowiki>amhej</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> actually does matter for a lot of damage. It's imperative to treat </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="varanussmercy">[[File:Varanus's Mercy.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448697873603498045.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>varanussmercy</nowiki>|<nowiki>varanussmercy</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="eofspec">[[File:Essence of Finality.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>eofspec</nowiki>|<nowiki>eofspec</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> as a switch, not </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="amhej">[[File:Am-hej.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448070604937891921.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>amhej</nowiki>|<nowiki>amhej</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> as a switch.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="varanussmercy">[[File:Varanus's Mercy.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448697873603498045.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>varanussmercy</nowiki>|<nowiki>varanussmercy</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="eofspec">[[File:Essence of Finality.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>eofspec</nowiki>|<nowiki>eofspec</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> and </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="dragonclaw">[[File:Dragon claw.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/779048041088024606.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>dragonclaw</nowiki>|<nowiki>dragonclaw</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="eofspec">[[File:Essence of Finality.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>eofspec</nowiki>|<nowiki>eofspec</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> can be switched</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ When using </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="dba">[[File:Dragon battleaxe.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/603979368850653216.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>dba</nowiki>|<nowiki>dba</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="spec">[[File:Weapon Special Attack.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>spec</nowiki>|<nowiki>spec</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>, it's recommended to spec immediately if Vorkath is around 860k the moment you use </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="smoketendrils">[[File:Smoke Tendrils.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536257336130404372.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>smoketendrils</nowiki>|<nowiki>smoketendrils</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>. This allows you to build up more adrenaline immediately after DBA spec while ensuring a perfect P2.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Keep </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="zemouregalsnexus">[[File:Zemouregal's nexus.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1179716261681307728.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>zemouregalsnexus</nowiki>|<nowiki>zemouregalsnexus</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> on until you use </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="divert">[[File:Divert.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>divert</nowiki>|<nowiki>divert</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>, then swap to the </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="nodonspikeharness">[[File:Nodon spike harness.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1449363594495135776.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>nodonspikeharness</nowiki>|<nowiki>nodonspikeharness</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ If you end up using </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="overpower">[[File:Overpower.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>overpower</nowiki>|<nowiki>overpower</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> when Zemouregal has around 70k LP left, move </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="gmaul">[[File:Granite maul.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/796989663051120640.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>gmaul</nowiki>|<nowiki>gmaul</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="eofspec">[[File:Essence of Finality.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>eofspec</nowiki>|<nowiki>eofspec</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> up and use it with </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="overpower">[[File:Overpower.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>overpower</nowiki>|<nowiki>overpower</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> to instantly KO Zemouregal.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Replace </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="powerburstofacceleration">[[File:Powerburst of acceleration (4).png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/756236265472524418.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>powerburstofacceleration</nowiki>|<nowiki>powerburstofacceleration</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> with </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="powerburstofvitality">[[File:Powerburst of vitality (4).png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>powerburstofvitality</nowiki>|<nowiki>powerburstofvitality</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> for safer kills, and use it after </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="gbarge">[[File:Greater Barge.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>gbarge</nowiki>|<nowiki>gbarge</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Tectonic works almost just as well, but will be noticeably slower by a couple seconds.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Sometimes can </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="lengmh">[[File:Dark Shard of Leng.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/883134308146098227.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>lengmh</nowiki>|<nowiki>lengmh</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="spec">[[File:Weapon Special Attack.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>spec</nowiki>|<nowiki>spec</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> + </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="gmaul">[[File:Granite maul.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/796989663051120640.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>gmaul</nowiki>|<nowiki>gmaul</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="eofspec">[[File:Essence of Finality.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>eofspec</nowiki>|<nowiki>eofspec</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> if 3+ stacks and ~70k health.</nowiki></p>
